title: Step 59-E Home merchandising and promotional surfaces
description: Implement bounded Home merchandising on top of the authoritative Stage-59-C GET /products loader and Stage-59-D discovery surface. Preserve backend response order, render at most six valid product cards with server-authoritative current_toman and availability only, use neutral media placeholders instead of invented assets, link product cards only to the existing Step-61 /product/:slug placeholder, add a Buying Guide entry to the existing /articles Step-66 placeholder, and add a wholesale CTA to the existing /wholesale Step-65 placeholder without inventing wholesale eligibility, prices or discounts. Do not implement a first-purchase festival because no canonical main Product Vision/Business Rules evidence currently supports that campaign. Do not add client ranking, recommendation scoring, fake discounts, fake stock counts, campaign percentages, new APIs, backend rules, listing/filter behavior or downstream route implementations.

acceptance_criteria.description: Home merchandising uses only valid products from the existing GET /products ready state, preserves response order, applies no client ranking/recommendation, and caps the surface at six cards.

Each rendered card uses backend-provided name, current_toman and availability only; Toman is explicit, no fake stock count/discount/wholesale price is introduced, and neutral text media placeholders replace invented imagery.
Product cards link only to existing /product/:slug; Product Detail remains Step 61 placeholder.
Home exposes Buying Guide entry to /articles and wholesale CTA to /wholesale without implementing those downstream Step-66/65 routes or claiming unverified campaign/wholesale pricing.
No first-purchase promotion, campaign percentage, wallet, brown styling, new API, backend mutation or downstream listing/product/content/wholesale implementation is added.

Root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Browser Quality, deterministic review, active exact-artifact lock, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification pass before Stage 59-F starts.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 59-E is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 59-F remains blocked until protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green.
